overall_assessment: Statistical methodology is sound for the primary AUROC comparisons. The McNemar test degeneracy is a limitation but does not affect the AUROC-based conclusions. Bootstrap CIs are correctly computed. Multiple testing correction is applied (Bonferroni α=0.0017). No P0 issues.

findings.title: McNemar test is uninformative when b=c=0
findings.detail: E6 McNemar test: b=0, c=0, p=1.0. This occurs because both B02 and B08 use threshold=1.0 (predict all CHANGED), making identical predictions. The McNemar test cannot distinguish methods that make identical predictions. AUROC comparison is valid but the inferential test for H2 is effectively null.
findings.fix_notes: DOCUMENTED in Phase 4 gate P2. H2 verdict is based on AUROC CI overlap, not McNemar. CIs do not overlap (AST lower bound > SBG upper bound).

findings.title: Bootstrap CI width is large relative to effect sizes
findings.detail: SBG AUROC CI [0.375, 0.472] spans 0.097. Best baseline CI [0.509, 0.594] spans 0.085. These CIs do not overlap, which supports the ordering claim, but the absolute values are so close to 0.5 (chance) that the effect sizes are small. Cohen's d ≈ 0.45 for SBG vs AST — medium effect, borderline.
findings.fix_notes: Effect sizes reported in Phase 4 gate. Borderline medium effect noted.

findings.title: Permutation test for variance difference (E3) may have low power with n=744
findings.detail: E3 permutation test p=1.0 — extreme result suggesting test has degenerate behavior. A p-value of exactly 1.0 means zero permutations produced a diff as large as observed. This should be p=0.0 if observed diff is larger than all permutations, or 1.0 if all permutations are larger. Need to verify test direction.
findings.fix_notes: E3 shows SP_std > SC_std: var(SP) > var(SC). p=1.0 means NO permutation produced var(B)-var(A) >= observed (which is negative). H3 is clearly NOT SUPPORTED — the direction is wrong, not just non-significant.

findings.title: Power analysis was for N=800, actual test has N=744
findings.detail: Phase 1 power analysis required N=800 for 80% power at d=0.3. Actual test split has N=744 — slightly underpowered.
findings.fix_notes: DOCUMENTED in Phase 4 gate. Power is marginally adequate for d=0.3. For d=0.5 (medium), power is >90% at N=744.
